title: Every cookie `Core\Response::addCookie` writes is `Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Path=/` unless the call site says otherwise
divergesFromPhp: `setcookie` defaults to no `Secure`, no `HttpOnly` and no `SameSite`; here every cookie starts with all three, `SameSite` is an enum rather than a string, and a script-readable cookie is one written field at the call
